items.title: Researchers working on artificial placentas for premature babies
items.description: The aim of the technology is to give babies born too soon a few more weeks to grow and develop in womb-like conditions, and a better chance of a long and healthy life.

items.title: 'Failed' university scheme hurting home ownership prospects
items.description: There are calls for the government to dump a scheme that has more than doubled the cost of some degrees.

items.title: Footage shows Australian man handcuffed by ICE agents in Las Vegas airport
items.description: The 57-year-old was later arrested for overstaying his Visa and is currently detained at an ICE processing centre in California.

items.title: Why India's reopening a nuclear power plant built in the 1960s
items.description: Despite repeated setbacks and isolation, India continues to hold onto its nuclear dream.

items.title: Olympic swimmers return to iconic Sydney pool for 50-year reunion
items.description: Members of the 1976 Australian Olympic swim team return to North Sydney Olympic pool to celebrate their 50-year reunion and revisit the venue that shaped their careers.

items.title: China has stockpiled 'huge quantities' of frozen beef for this moment
items.description: As imports from Australia hit a wall because of large tariffs, China turns to its historically high stockpile of frozen beef.

items.title: 'Dangerously close to becoming normalised': Government responds to Islamophobia report
items.description: The Albanese government's long-awaited response to its special envoy's report on Islamophobia has rejected calls for an overhaul of counter-terror laws.

items.title: Early-onset bowel cancer becoming more prevalent as signs are missed
items.description: Georgie Cauchi had blood in her stool, constant pain and was struggling to get out of bed, but still in her 20s doctors told her she was too young to have bowel cancer. When it was finally discovered several years later, the tumour had grown so large it was blocking her entire bowel.

items.title: The race to find routes around the Strait of Hormuz and which nation is winning
items.description: Amid uncertainty around the Strait of Hormuz, for months Gulf countries and oil companies have been finding ways to bypass the choke point.

items.title: Battery installation rates collapse as 'solar-coaster' strikes back

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
